verdict.rationale: Undermind documents cross-paper extraction: it reads full-text PDFs in parallel and answers the same specific questions across many papers, including figures and tables. It can also generate custom tables and offers relevance assessment with sort/filter, and enterprise batch processing via API. It does not document a structured screening workflow with explicitly defined, consistently applied inclusion/exclusion criteria. A meta-analysis author also reported it missed a sample-size exclusion, which undercuts reliable criteria-based screening. Missing for 10: a documented screening workflow with user-defined inclusion/exclusion criteria, a structured extraction schema or audit trail, and independent hands-on corroboration of consistent screening.
